correctness.rationale: For the ordinary open-neighborhood complex of KG(n,2), a simplex of pair-vertices is exactly an edge-set graph on [n] with at least two isolated labels. For a permutation with c ground cycles and f fixed labels, signed orbit-support inclusion-exclusion gives reduced Lefschetz number (-1)^c(f²−3f+1). With the established Nilakantan–Singh homology concentration in dimension n−4, its top trace is sgn(g)(f²−3f+1). The sum of characters of ∧²Std and S^(n−2,2), twisted by sign, yields the two claimed conjugate Specht modules and no S_n or A_n invariants; finite-group averaging after subdivision gives the quotient rational acyclicity, not contractibility. Independently reconstructed symbolic support proof and compared all 85 conjugacy classes for n=5..9 in separate exact arithmetic; finite tests are not the all-n proof.
